source.listing_description:
High-adhesion 257x257mm / 10.1x10.1in dual-sided flexible build plate for Bambu Lab 3D printers ensures stable printing and easy model removal.

This build plate solves common printing problems like warping and adhesion failure by providing a specially coated PEI surface that grips filament effectively. It allows you to print with confidence and remove models effortlessly using the flexible steel plate design.

Key Features

  • Strong Adhesion: Black PEI surface provides firm filament stickiness for even printing without warpage.
  • Easy Model Removal: Flexible spring steel lets you bend the plate gently after printing to pop off models without tools.
  • Double-Sided Use: Features unique colourful patterns on both sides for versatile printing options.
  • Durable Material: Made from high-strength spring steel for long-lasting use and resistance to wear.
  • Easy to Clean: Wipe with wet tissue or alcohol before printing to remove dust or fingerprints.

Specifications

  • Size: 257mm x 257mm / 10.1in x 10.1in
  • Material: Spring Steel with PEI Coating
  • Weight: Approximately 150g / 5.3oz
  • Compatible Models: Bambu Lab X1, X1C, X1E, P1P, P1S, P2S, A1
  • Color/Finish: Various multi-color holographic patterns, black PEI smooth surface
  • Included: 1x Double-sided 3D Printer Build Plate
